# baffinbay_custom_page (Resource)

Manages a Baffin Bay Custom Page.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) The HTML content of the custom page.
- `name` (String) The name of the custom page file.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the custom page.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import baffinbay_custom_page.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
